method: Exact browser vendor Rapier injection and createChipPhysics(count=36,sizeScale=1.15,sizeVariation=.1), closed high-poly visual skin only; independent triangle, hull-plane and edge topology checks.

chips.method: Independent face-local elliptical breaks, angled cleavage ridges, small scars and stepped edge chips; shared indexed topology with positive radial factors. Original hull corners remain support anchors. Conservative local displacement <=0.55 mm; zero face support gap.
